summary: Revoke offline tokens with a curl POST to sso.redhat.com's openid-connect/revoke endpoint (client_id cloud-services, token=${REFRESH_TOKEN}); this revokes all previously generated offline tokens, after which you regenerate one.
questions: How do I revoke an automation hub offline token?
Does revoking a token revoke all my offline tokens?
How do I rotate the automation hub token?
